name: Woodnote
summary: A warm glass sales dashboard for a furniture workshop, with a hanging-tag deal board
about: A sales dashboard for a business that sells to designers, hotels, shops and walk-in buyers, shown with sample data from a Lahore furniture workshop. Frosted sand-glass panels catch a light that follows your pointer, enquiries hang like wooden tags on a drag-and-drop board, and won deals drop onto a live workshop line.
how: Use the floating rail on the left (a dock at the bottom on phones) to move between the eight pages.
On Overview, switch 7D, 30D or 12M to morph the sales chart; move the pointer over a panel to see the glass light up.
On Deal board, drag a tag to the next peg; dropping it on In production creates a workshop order. Keyboard users press Shift with an arrow key or use the grip.
Filter the board by customer type, open a tag to move it on, mark it lost, edit or delete it.
Watch pieces move between stations on Workshop line, pause the line or rush a piece forward.
Search, sort and filter Orders and Customers, and add or edit pieces in the Catalog.
Settings saves workshop details, alert switches, the theme and can reset the demo data.
